summary: Backend-only testing for Synthetic Sparks. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_synthetic_sparks_backend.py covering auth (register/login/me/logout, cookie + Bearer), character create/get, save/load, checkpoint/restore, arena score + leaderboard, admin seeding, and unauthenticated 401 paths. 23/23 tests passed against the public ingress URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Verified MongoDB indexes (users.email unique, game_saves.user_id unique, arena_scores.score desc) and admin user seeded with role=admin.

minor.issue: Listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but NOT implemented in backend/server.py. Either implement it or remove from docs. Store logic appears to be fully client-side, so doc is likely stale.
No brute-force lockout implemented. Playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts. Not blocking for MVP but recommended for production.

Cookies set with secure=False. Acceptable for local dev / cross-origin preview, but for production over HTTPS use secure=True + samesite='none' to allow cross-site cookie auth from the Expo web bundle.

action_items: Optional: implement /api/game/buy-item or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to remove the stale reference.
Optional: add brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts) on /api/auth/login per playbook.
Optional: switch cookies to secure=True + samesite='none' for production HTTPS deployment so the Expo web bundle on a different origin retains cookie auth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~390 lines) - acceptable size; clean separation of concerns.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded from responses via `del user['_id']` and projection `{_id: 0}`.
Bearer fallback in get_current_user works correctly alongside httpOnly cookies (verified via tests).
default_game_state is well-aligned with the frontend constants per problem statement.
Admin seed logic is idempotent and updates the password if it changed - matches playbook expectations.
Arena leaderboard aggregation correctly returns top-20 distinct users sorted by best score.
seed_data_creation: Tests register fresh users with random uuid emails (test_<hex>@test.com / Password123). Each test class that needs a clean user registers its own. Admin (admin@example.com/admin123) is seeded by backend startup. No persistent test pollution beyond ephemeral users + leaderboard scores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testing not yet done. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://emerged-academy.preview.emergentagent.com. Test flow: title -> login (admin@example.com/admin123) or register -> character-create -> game (joystick + A/B buttons). AsyncStorage holds the access_token; Bearer header is sent on native, cookies on web. All 23 backend tests pass and can be re-run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_synthetic_sparks_backend.py -v
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All requested backend endpoints behave as specified in the review request: JWT issued in JSON + httpOnly cookies, Bearer fallback works, character defaults match frontend, save/checkpoint/restore round-trips data correctly, arena leaderboard returns sorted top-20 entries, MongoDB indexes (email unique, user_id unique, score desc) are present, admin user is seeded with role=admin.
